meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 把项目在 claude-mem 里的完整时间线按 ISO 周拆成文件,再逐周串行调用子代理,每周产出一章叙事摘要;每章承接上一周的 carry-forward 块,最后一章改写「Where We Are」。文件按周编号重命名排序。
howto.when: 当你要求「weekly digests」「week-by-week story」「serial timeline」等,或想逐周续写项目历史章节时触发;若只想要一份单篇长报告,则用 timeline-report。

say.text: 给这个项目做每周摘要,从第一周写到最近一周
用逐周故事的形式讲一下这个项目的开发历史
say.note: 每周一章,后一章承接上一周的 carry-forward

say.text: 接着上一周继续写这个项目的时间线故事
say.note: 从上一周的 carry-forward 块往下续写

howto.what_en: Splits a project's claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs subagents one week at a time, one narrative chapter per week. Each chapter inherits the prior week's carry-forward block; the last chapter writes 'Where We Are'.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', 'serial timeline' or similar; use timeline-report instead if they want a single long report.

say_en.text: Make weekly digests for this project, from the first week to the latest.
say_en.note: Writes one chapter per ISO week into docs/timeline-weeks

say_en.text: Tell this project's history as a week-by-week serial story.
say_en.note: Each chapter carries forward the prior week

say_en.text: Continue the timeline story from the last week.
